notes.content: This is a typewritten continuation of a letter with one display, four subsequent body paragraphs and a closing line, but no signature. It comments on a regularity assertion, normality and reducedness assumptions, tame ramification, and the groups in 10.2 and 10.3. Every line, reference, punctuation mark and agreed word was read from the supplied halves. The spelling slips lemme, analoguous (joined across its physical line-end hyphen), normalisty, whith, and considred are retained. No diagrams, free-standing drawings, authorial marginal comments, date, address or letterhead appear. The only handwritten element is the small archival 11 at lower left, represented as a comment. Mathematical assertions have been transcribed, not proved.
author_checks: The theorem 7.1 paragraph says that 'the normality assumptions as well as reducedness assumptions are quite superfluous' and 'only lemme 7.2. is used'; these are the author's claims, unverified in this run.

The same paragraph says 'the proof on page 32 seems to me' followed by a cancelled five-cell fragment, then 'a little short at one point; I tried to indicate some details in the margin.' No purported proof from that other page was inspected.
The tame-ramification paragraph says 'The proof would, I guess, require to use the results of sections 7 and 8 in a slightly different form'; this is carried as an unverified authorial assessment.
The same paragraph conditions the assertion with 'provided we assume a statement of the type 7.2. in paragraph 7'; the cited statement was not independently checked.
titles_dates_pages: No title, date, authorial page number, address or signature is visible.
Archive sheet number 11 appears at lower left and is preserved only in a LaTeX comment.
Page 32 is cited in the body; 7.1, 7.2, 9.4, 10.2 and 10.3 are textual references, not page foliation.
math_reading_decisions: Half a independently confirms all display indices and nested exponent indices, both punctuation runs, the quotient slash, and the absence of brackets around the generator list. No regularity proof was attempted because its full hypotheses are not on this page.
The plain capitals in (R_k) and (S_k) are retained; the claims about those properties are background statements, unverified.
Half b independently confirms both empty group bases and both blank second arguments. H's pi restorations are excluded. No identification or computation of these groups was performed.
The parenthesized p exponent is visually present only on the second group expression; there is no prime or exclamation sign at that position.
Only visual notation and syntax were inspected. No mathematical statement was proved or otherwise independently checked; there are no proof-check events.

brief_feedback: The rule counting changes in C's explicit doubt encoding was applied to localization from whole-word alternatives to the actually unresolved initial/cell (differences 04, 06 and 11). The lexical candidates themselves did not change.
The paper-edge rule was applied by marking only the surviving terminal-glyph candidate in particular and adding a local cutoff comment. No second crop or reconstruction of the lost shoulder was made.

Start time was captured before page-source inspection, after reading the brief. The two supplied halves align at whole-image y offsets 0 and 1003; minor JPEG recompression prevents exact pixel identity. No OCR, external sources, other pages, other readers, or compilation were used.
